statement: let W := ∏ p ∈ (Finset.range 758).filter Nat.Prime, p; 6*W < 10^316 ∧ (10:ℕ)^316 < 7*W ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 1≤k → k≤6 → let n := k*W; (∀ p≤757, p.Prime → ¬ (n-p).Prime) ∧ (∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p+q=n))
